fields.statement: Since #210 run drivers are headless (no REX_BLOCK), so rhiza's own blocked-run notice (title = tab, msg naming change set, step and question) is never written; the only status Rex sees is Claude Code's native OSC 7501 report in the agent tab, which chimes but shows no banner. Where should a headless run's blocked notice be written? / The missing banner (chime heard, no macOS banner) is Rex's presentation choice, which its docs leave undocumented. How should the Rex upstream report be handled?
